title.en: Read a resource from your own CoAP server
title.hinglish: Apne CoAP server se resource padho

why.en: Uses the libcoap client against a CoAP server you run yourself (for example a local test server).
why.hinglish: libcoap client ko aapke khud ke chalaye CoAP server (jaise local test server) par use karta hai.

expect.en: Needs libcoap's coap-client and a CoAP server on your own machine; otherwise it times out after the CoAP retries (2 s, 4 s, ...), which is itself the backoff lesson. A working server prints the payload, for example 22.5. Output varies.
expect.hinglish: libcoap ka coap-client aur aapki apni machine par CoAP server chahiye; warna CoAP retries (2 s, 4 s, ...) ke baad timeout ho jaata hai, jo khud backoff ka lesson hai. Chalta hua server payload print karta hai, jaise 22.5. Output alag ho sakta hai.

title.en: Check that UDP 5683 is free on your PC
title.hinglish: Dekho aapke PC par UDP 5683 free hai ya nahi

why.en: Lists local UDP listeners so you can see whether a CoAP server is running here.
why.hinglish: Local UDP listeners list karta hai taaki dikhe ki yahan CoAP server chal raha hai ya nahi.

expect.en: Usually no output, meaning nothing listens on 5683. If you started a CoAP server you see a line with 0.0.0.0:5683 or *:5683.
expect.hinglish: Aam taur par koi output nahi, matlab 5683 par kuch nahi sun raha. Agar aapne CoAP server chalaya hai to 0.0.0.0:5683 ya *:5683 wali line dikhegi.

title.en: See CoAP messages in the capture

why.en: Open the downloaded .pcap and read type, code, Message ID and token.
why.hinglish: Download kiya .pcap kholo aur type, code, Message ID aur token padho.

expect.en: You see CON GET, ACK 2.05 Content, the Observe notifications and the empty ACK. Click a packet and expand the CoAP tree for options like Uri-Path and Observe.
expect.hinglish: CON GET, ACK 2.05 Content, Observe notifications aur empty ACK dikhte hain. Packet par click karke CoAP tree expand karo aur Uri-Path aur Observe jaise options dekho.

why.en: Shows repeated Message IDs and error codes (class 4 and 5).
why.hinglish: Repeated Message IDs aur error codes (class 4 aur 5) dikhata hai.

expect.en: Observe notifications, the 4.04 reply and the three copies of MID 0x7d40 from the lost-CON capture match, depending on which scenario you opened.
expect.hinglish: Aapne kaunsa scenario khola us par depend karke Observe notifications, 4.04 reply aur lost-CON capture ki MID 0x7d40 ki teen copies match hoti hain.
